name: told_check
description: Before telling the person something (a digest item, a reminder, news), check whether they were already told: by its topic key, or by text (matching words). Answers {told: bool, matches: [{key, text, channel, bot, at, ago}]}. Covers the last 7 days by default (up to 30) on this machine, including every alert already sent (asks, finished work, failures, merges, notify_person notes, which are recorded by themselves). Alerting is notify_person's policy (needs_you, done, or a routine's reminder or digest); this only tells you what was already said.

key.description: The topic key, e.g. lunch-dana-1028 (as given to told_mark).

text.description: The text you are about to say; matched by its words.

days.description: How many days back (default 7, at most 30).

name: told_mark
description: Record that you told the person something without an alert (in a digest, a room post, a chat answer, your Space, an email), so you and other bots skip it next time. Alerts, notify_person's included, are recorded by themselves. key: a short stable topic key (e.g. lunch-dana-1028); without one, it is made from the text. channel: digest, room, chat, email or other. Answers {key}.

key.description: A short stable topic key; made from the text when omitted.

text.description: What you told them, in a sentence.

channel.description: digest, room, chat, email or other (default chat).

name: task_board_list
description: List the shared task board: open items by default (all includes done and dropped). Answers {text, items}: text is one line per item, [status] title (id; @owner; %project; due D; group), and items has the full records.

status.description: todo, doing, blocked, done or dropped; several separated by commas.

owner.description: A bot's name or id, me for yourself, or person.

name: task_board_add
description: Add an item to the shared task board. Answers {id}.

title.description: What is to be done (at most 300 characters).

status.description: todo (default), doing, blocked, done or dropped.

owner.description: A bot's name or id, me for yourself, or person (default).

links.description: URLs, thread ids or paths: a JSON array, or a string split on spaces and commas (at most 20).

name: task_board_update
description: Change an item on the task board: only the fields you give change. Answers {id}.

status.description: todo, doing, blocked, done or dropped.

owner.description: A bot's name or id, me for yourself, or person.

links.description: Replaces the links: a JSON array, or a string split on spaces and commas.

notes_append.description: A line added to the notes.

name: task_board_remove
description: Delete an item from the task board for good. Prefer task_board_update with status dropped, which keeps a record.

name: task_board_import
description: Import a markdown todo list (checkbox items `- [ ]`, `- [x]`, `- [~]`; headings become groups). Lines without a checkbox are not imported and are returned as `skipped`. Importing the same list again adds nothing. Answers {added, duplicates, skipped}.

project.description: Put every item in this project (a name or id).

owner.description: A bot's name or id, me for yourself, or person (default).
